mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals robust demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over the previous month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the previous quarter signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
